### Day 45: 2 Samuel 5:6–12
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-45-2-samuel-5-612.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:6-12
Points:
- David endured roughly fifteen confusing years of danger before seeing God's promise of kingship fulfilled.
- Capturing the fortified city of Zion and gaining royal favor showed David that God had established him.
- In confusing and painful seasons, recalling what we know about God's character restores our strength.
- Personal hardships teach us from real experience that God is our rock, fortress, and refuge.
- We may not understand why circumstances happen, but we can always trust who God is.

### Bible Pathways - April 12
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-1323754.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:6-7
Points:
- The Jebusite fortress in Jerusalem had to be conquered before God's dwelling place could be established there.
- The captured stronghold of Zion pictures hidden, unyielded strongholds deep within our hearts and thoughts.
- Secret strongholds of the fleshly mind keep Christ from being absolute Lord over our lives.
- Carnal impulses subtly resist dedicating our time, talents, and resources fully to God.
- Believers overcome inward strongholds through daily scripture reading and active obedience to God's will.
